name: Bahia
summary: Four horizontal stripes of white and red, with a blue canton holding a white triangle. Strongly influenced by the US flag, with a Masonic-style triangle.
origin: The physician Deocleciano Ramos presented the flag at a Republican Party meeting in Salvador on 25 May 1889. The triangle echoes the 1789 Inconfidência Mineira. Governor Juracy Magalhães made it official on 11 June 1960.

symbols.name: White triangle
symbols.description: A triangle in the blue canton.
symbols.meaning: Freedom and equality, echoing Freemasonry and the Inconfidência Mineira.

facts: Salvador, the capital, was Brazil's first capital (1549–1763).
Red, white and blue were also used in the 1798 Revolt of the Tailors.
clues: Red and white stripes with a blue canton containing a white triangle.
It was first a Republican Party flag in 1889.
The state of Brazil's first capital.
